note: Both sets suffer from significant duplication and contain hallucinated claims with fabricated quotes (e.g., both claim 20,000 PSI when text says 25,000 PSI). However, Set A is slightly better because its composition error (55% Titanium) falls within the text's stated range (44-55%), whereas Set B's composition error (50% Nickel) contradicts the text's range (55-65%). Set A also captures high-level attributes like 'chemical make-up' and 'capability' that Set B misses.
